bounded_question: What does the node #115 fourth stats consumer (0x5efa010) emit into the out map for each compaction level and in total, and how are its 21 per-level metric values computed?

outer_insert.note: inserts metric ids 1..21 into one inner map<std::map<int, double>>

inner_insert.note: find-or-insert for one (key, double) slot; 21 call sites, all inside outer_insert

context_map.built_by: static initializer 0x5efbd80: 21 {int, string, string} entries (stride 0x48) pair_range_inserted via 0x5ef0ea0 (count 21, first = -0x1900(%rbp))
context_map.node_layout: header 32 B; int key @+0x20; first string @+0x28 (ptr @+0x28, size @+0x30, SSO @+0x38); second string @+0x48 (ptr @+0x48, size @+0x50, SSO @+0x58)

metric_formulas.note: 0x5ef1630, for one level struct L (i64 fields unless noted) and the caller's (elem_count, flagged_count, S, dense, ratio). All (double) conversions of i64 values use the u64-to-double fixup (t = (v>>1)|(v&1), convert, double) when the high bit is set. K2_30 = 2**-30 (.rodata 0x459c48), K2_20 = 2**-20 (.rodata 0x459638), base = (double)(L+0x00 + 1) / 1e6.
metric_formulas.correction: Metric 17's else branch is 0.0 (outer_insert.txt 0x5ef19ee: xmm0 is zeroed before the L+0x68 test, and the zero branch jumps straight to the store). An earlier trace draft had recorded it as (double)L+0x00 / 1e6; the verbatim excerpt corrects that.

ratio.per_level: 0.0 for level 0, or when (L+0x20 + L+0x10) == 0; else (double)(L+0x30 + L+0x28) / (double)(L+0x20 + L+0x10) (filler.txt 0x5ef22e2..0x5ef2329)

sum_node.label: Sum
sum_node.insert_rule: Inserted unconditionally after the per-level loop (filler.txt 0x5ef251a..0x5ef2644): the lower_bound + node-create + inner-map move-assign run on both the normal loop exit (jump to 0x5ef2555) and the count==0 / alternate paths (which jump to 0x5ef251a). Only the ratio is gated on (owner+0x90 + owner+0x98) != 0.
sum_node.args_to_outer_insert: elem_count = summed elem counts (32-bit), flagged_count = summed flagged counts (32-bit), S = summed S (double), dense = 0.0, ratio = sum_ratio, level struct = the accumulated snapshot
sum_node.snapshot: 188-byte struct (0xbc), lane-wise paddq/paddd sum of the processed level structs (filler.txt 0x5ef21b0..0x5ef229b); +0x68 accumulates as i32

level_skip_rule: A level is skipped (no snapshot accumulation, no metric insert, no outer-map node) when its first 16 bytes are both zero AND its element count is 0 (filler.txt 0x5ef2197..0x5ef21aa). Its elem/flagged counts still join the Sum totals (accumulated at 0x5ef216b/0x5ef218b, before the skip test); its S and dense do not.

alternate_path.note: Not fully modelled. When the subobject byte at owner+0x788+0x5a8 == 2, the filler takes the alternate entry (0x5ef272a: count = owner+0x778, ebp = 1); if ebp <= 0 it jumps to the Sum phase (0x5ef251a) with zeroed totals. The alternate loop-entry deltas (0x58(rsp) = 0, edi = 0, r13d = 0 at 0x5ef270f) are recorded but the alternate src layout is not pinned in this packet.

main_emission.label: "Sum" for marker -1, else "L" + decimal(marker) (the decimal uses the same digit-pair table and divide-by-100 magic as the final routine)
main_emission.value_format: fmt_pct("%f", double) via 0x5eec680 (format "%f" at 0x432165, size 0x148, global at 0x64ed730): 6 decimal places
main_emission.insert: insert-or-assign into the out map via map_node_create 0x5ef3ed0 (pair: key string at rsp+0xb0, value string at r13; node: key string @+0x20, value string @+0x40) and string_move_assign 0x5eebb20
main_emission.after_loop: calls the summary consumer 0x5ef5d40, then destroys the outer tree via 0x5eec510

final_summary.loop: i = 0..2; ebp = 0 for i = 0, then 1; tag = tag_index(i, ebp); skip when tag == 0xe; name = name_builder(i, ebp); value = *(owner + 0xb8 + tag*8) as u64; out[name] = decimal(value) via u64str 0x5d4f970 + map_find_insert 0x5ef40a0 + string_move_assign 0x5eebb20
final_summary.correction: The tag-selected offsets are owner+0xb8, +0xd0, +0xe0 (final.txt 0x5ef5db9: mov 0xb8(%rax,%rbx,8)). An earlier trace draft recorded +0xbd0/+0xbe0; the verbatim excerpt corrects that.
final_summary.accumulators: delays_total (0x18(rsp)) += value when ebp == 0; stops_total (0x10(rsp)) += value when ebp != 0. So delays_total = owner+0xb8, stops_total = owner+0xd0 + owner+0xe0.

name_parts.name_builder: part_a(i) + "-" + part_b(ebp), defined only for (i <= 2 or i == 4) and ebp in {0, 1}; else ""

decimal_conversion.note: The main routine's level-label decimal, the final routine's u64->string helper 0x5d4f970, and the model's to_decimal all use the same algorithm: digit-count dispatch, divide-by-10000 magic 0x346dc5d63886594b, divide-by-100 magic 0x28f5c28f5c28f5c3, and the 200-byte digit-pair table built from 13 .rodata chunks.

digit_pair_table.note: store_offsets are relative to the table base (main: rsp+0x1d0; the table is 200 bytes). The 13th chunk is stored unaligned at offset 185 (movups at 0x289), so its bytes 7..14 fill the table's last 8 bytes (offsets 192..199).
